ruleDefinitions.name: Active Directory Structure Export Via Csvde.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "csvde.exe" in order to export organizational Active Directory structure.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\csvde\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "csvde\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-f.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i.*"))
